This page provides **lists of best-selling books and book series** to date and in any language. *"Best-selling"* refers to the estimated number of copies sold of each book, rather than the number of books [printed](Printed "Printed") or currently owned. [Comics](Comic_book "Comic book") and [textbooks](Textbook "Textbook") are not included in this list. The books are listed according to the highest sales estimate as reported in reliable, independent sources. This list is incomplete because many books lack comprehensive sales figures, such as *[The Count of Monte Cristo](The_Count_of_Monte_Cristo "The Count of Monte Cristo")* by [Alexandre Dumas](Alexandre_Dumas "Alexandre Dumas"),[[1]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-1) *[Don Quixote](Don_Quixote "Don Quixote")* by [Miguel de Cervantes](Miguel_de_Cervantes "Miguel de Cervantes"),[[2]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-2) *[Journey to the West](Journey_to_the_West "Journey to the West")* by [Wu Cheng'en](Wu_Cheng'en "Wu Cheng'en")[[3]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-3) and *[The Lord of the Rings](The_Lord_of_the_Rings "The Lord of the Rings")*[[4]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-4) (which has been sold as both a trilogy of books, *[The Fellowship of the Ring](The_Fellowship_of_the_Ring "The Fellowship of the Ring")*, *[The Two Towers](The_Two_Towers "The Two Towers")*, and *[The Return of the King](The_Return_of_the_King "The Return of the King")*, and as a single issue) by [J. R. R. Tolkien](J._R._R._Tolkien "J. R. R. Tolkien").

According to *[Guinness World Records](Guinness_World_Records "Guinness World Records")* as of 1995, the <Bible> is the best selling book of all time with an estimated 5 billion copies sold and distributed.[[5]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-guinnessworldrecords-5) Sales estimates for other printed [religious texts](Religious_texts "Religious texts") include at least 800 million copies for the <Qur'an> and 190 million copies for the [Book of Mormon](Book_of_Mormon "Book of Mormon").[[6]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-6) Also, a single publisher has produced more than 140 million copies of the [Bhagavad Gita](Bhagavad_Gita "Bhagavad Gita"). The total number could be much higher.[[7]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-7) Among non-religious texts, the *[Quotations from Chairman Mao Tse-tung](Quotations_from_Chairman_Mao_Tse-tung "Quotations from Chairman Mao Tse-tung")*, also known as the *Little Red Book*, has produced a wide array of sales and distribution figures—with estimates ranging from 800 million[[5]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-guinnessworldrecords-5) to over 6.5 billion printed volumes.[[8]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-8) Some claim the distribution ran into the "billions"[[9]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-9) and some cite "over a billion" official volumes between 1966 and 1969 alone as well as "untold numbers of unofficial local reprints and unofficial translations".[[10]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-10)[[11]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-11) Exact print figures for these and other books may also be missing or unreliable since these kinds of books may be produced by many different and unrelated publishers, in some cases over many centuries. All books of a religious, ideological, philosophical or political nature have thus been excluded from the lists of best-selling books below for these reasons.

Having sold more than 600 million copies worldwide*,[[12]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-Harry_Potter_copies-12) [Harry Potter](Harry_Potter "Harry Potter")* by [J. K. Rowling](J._K._Rowling "J. K. Rowling") is the best-selling book series in history. The first [novel](Novel "Novel") in the series, *[Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone](Harry_Potter_and_the_Philosopher's_Stone "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone")*, has sold in excess of 120 million copies,[[13]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-Chalton_2017_129-13) making it one of the best-selling books of all time. As of June 2017, the series has been translated into 85 languages,[[14]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-14) placing *Harry Potter* among history's [most translated literary works](List_of_literary_works_by_number_of_translations "List of literary works by number of translations"). The last four books in the series consecutively set records as the fastest-selling books of all time, where the final installment, *[Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows](Harry_Potter_and_the_Deathly_Hallows "Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows")*, sold roughly fifteen million copies worldwide within twenty-four hours of its release.[[15]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-15)[[16]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-16) With twelve million books printed in the first US run, it also holds the record for the highest initial print run for any book in history.[[17]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-17)[[18]](List_of_best-selling_books#cite_note-18)
